title: content/objects.yaml — object & item kinds carrying supply Effect (D9/D10), incl. flora

formula.description: A §6 Formula string (design.md §6), compiled by platform/config via engine/expr. Operands: terrain attrs, climate (moisture/temperature), `growth`, capability StatIDs (e.g. Dexterity). An unknown operand is a load-time failure (D10). Structural check here is non-empty string; semantic validation is platform/config's.

scalarOrFormula.description: Either a numeric constant or a §6 Formula string (engine/expr).

qtyRange.description: [min, max] inclusive integer quantity for a yield-table roll (seeded RNG). 0 <= min <= max (cross-field, enforced by platform/config beyond JSON Schema).

yieldEntry.description: One yield-table row (flora 1e). `chance` is a §6 Formula (typically `§6(Dexterity)`) → [0,1] success probability for a SEEDED roll; `qty` is the [min,max] amount on success. D7: chance composes a capability stat, NOT a per-action skill. D9: regen is this table refilling via growth, never a future-quantity field.

yieldTable.description: The yield table: an array of {item, chance, qty} rolled by a generic harvest action (Forage/Fell) with the seeded RNG (flora 1e, D12).

shade.description: flora shade PARAMETER formulas (flora 1d). radius/opacity = §6(growth, species). perception composes overlapping shade multiplicatively into LoS (no tiling, D11). engine/flora emits the parameter; perception computes the occlusion.

propagation.description: Seed-dispersal propagation (flora 1a option a): children spawn within `radius` of the parent Pos with probability `chance` · child_suitability · density_weight(neighbor_count). Environmental — NOT scaled by an actor stat.

flora.description: Marks an object_kind as a flora SPECIES (engine/flora; docs/flora.md). All behavior is §6 data (D4/D10); succession/forests emerge (D2/D3). Continuous `growth`; stages DERIVED via `stages` thresholds (D9: no stored stage, no future field).

stages.description: Ascending Growth thresholds in (0,1) → derived discrete stage index (count+1 stages). platform/config enforces strictly ascending, in-range (beyond JSON Schema).

yield_stage.description: Minimum derived stage index at which harvest.yields apply (e.g. only mature plants bear fruit). Optional; default 0.

propagate_stage.description: Minimum derived stage index at which the plant disperses seed (propagation). Optional; default 0.

death_threshold.description: θ: suitability below this counts toward death (1b). [0,1].

death_hysteresis.description: Consecutive sub-θ flora steps before object-mortality removal (1b option a; no flicker). >= 1.

yields.description: Either the LEGACY single item id (non-flora object_kinds: a fixed item placed into inventory) OR the flora YIELD TABLE [{item, chance, qty}] rolled with the seeded RNG (flora 1e). platform/config picks the form by shape.
